question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Gratitude
solution: The correct answer is **"Thanklessness."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Gratitude** means the quality of being thankful and showing appreciation. (आभारी होने और सराहना दिखाने का गुण) • **Example**: *Many of his patients gave works of art to Dr. Klein in **gratitude__**.* • The antonym of **"Gratitude" **is **"Thanklessness."** • **Thanklessness** means a lack of gratitude or appreciation. (कृतज्ञता प्रदर्शित न करना या महसूस न करना) __ • **Example**: *She shows **thanklessness**__ behaviour.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (Mercy)**: kindness shown by somebody/something who has the power to make somebody suffer. (दया, रहम (उस व्यक्ति द्वारा जो दूसरे को पीड़ित करने में समर्थ हो)) • **Option 3 (Appreciation)**: understanding and enjoyment of the value of something. (गुण-ग्रहण; समालोचना, गुण-दोष विवेचन) • **Option 4 (Care): **looking after somebody/something so that he/she/it has what he/she/it needs for his/her/its health and protection. (किसी की देखभाल या देखरेख) 2f:Tfbd, The correct answer is **"sole."**
